subject: Re: VPN not connecting from home
body:
Raj — quick follow-up on your ticket, and this closes it once the queue runs its next pass.

We traced the timeout to the migration's credential gap. The runbook says the fix is one step on the cohort record set, and the last open record is Lisa Chen (lisa.chen@northwindlabs.dev, HD-4480, verified by phone). Once that record's rotation completes, your VPN is restored on the next reconnect and Elena's badge clears too.

So the queue's next pass should complete that one record and both open tickets resolve together. Thanks for your patience — no other action needed on your side.
